notes.title: Kaya's Prophecy v1.1.10 Update + Camp Yog Sale!
notes.content:
Hey there adventurers,

We've just dropped a fresh small update for Kaya's Prophecy! Version 1.1.10 brings some QoL improvements and fixes that we hope you'll appreciate.

[h2]🔧 What's New in v1.1.10[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with the [i]Gunsmith[/i] Steam achievement
[*]Updated localization for better translation accuracy
[*]Removed [i]lock construction[/i] from [i]Options[/i] menu
[*]Improved construction colliders and individual lock buttons
[*]Re-enabled right-click mouse controls to pause/unpause the game[/list]

But this is only a small taste of what’s to come. We're working on a much larger update that's coming very soon, you won’t want to miss what we have planned! 


[h2]⚡ Camp Yog Sale Is Live! [/h2]

Kaya's Prophecy is now [b]30% OFF[/b] as part of our massive [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/CampYogSale]Camp Yog Sale[/url]! All of the Yogscast Games titles are on sale, plus we have a few exciting new demos for you to try. Perfect timing to start your adventure in Kaya’s Prophecy, or snag some other incredible titles from our catalogue!

notes.title: v1.1.9 New Stuff and Squashed Bugs
notes.content:
We hope you've all still been enjoying your adventures in Kaya's Prophecy! We've been listening to your feedback, and our v1.1.9 patch is out now with some of the most requested changes and bug fixes that the community has pointed out. We hope these improve your experience within the game! Keep the feedback coming, it really does help us shape Kaya's Prophecy into something better. Also, keep your eyes peeled for a bigger update coming soon! 

[h2]⚖️ Gameplay & Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*]Kâlades is now less likely to demand food as special requests, and may demand specific resources instead.
[*][spoiler]Bridge / Fake Queen / Fruit Plate cards[/spoiler] are no longer destroyable by lightning or other punishments from Kâlades.
[*]Increased first tribute level to 20 cards (up from 14).
[*]Adjusted booster pack drop rates to favour necessary items.
[/list]

[h2]🎴 Stacking & Collisions[/h2]
[list]
[*]When Kâlades eats food from the middle of your stack, the remaining food cards will now stack.
[*]Evil Blood should now stay stacked after making a purchase at the altar.
[*]Improved building colliders.
[*]Improved drag and collision behaviour on board.
[*]Improved card spawning and bouncing behaviour.
[*]Added [i][b]Lock Constructions[/b][/i] setting in [i][b]Options[/b][/i] so that builds will no longer be pushed around by spawning cards.  This is enabled by default.
[*]Can now stack usable cards. Stacked usable cards will automatically be completed in sequence.
[*]Similar cards will now stack together over longer distances.
[/list]

[h2]🎨 UI & Visuals[/h2]
[list]
[*]Scaled Quest UI up and added collapse/expand button.
[*]Adjusted position on HUD for plans and recipes.
[*]Added fire effects to campfire.
[*]Added smoke effect to broken totem to better visualize it being broken.
[*]Added visual effect for poison damage being taken.
[/list]

[h2]⭐ Other QOL changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Pause menu can now be exited using the Esc key.
[*]When unpausing with the spacebar, the game will return to the last speed used, rather than defaulting to the slowest speed.
[*]Villagers can now be renamed using characters from all supported languages.
[*]During combat, cards dropped in the middle of the screen will now automatically be applied to the correct target - either the player or an enemy.  In case of multiple enemies, the first enemy will be targeted by default, unless the card is dragged to the specific enemy.
[*]The [i][b]Animals Move[/b][/i] setting is now disabled by default.
[*]Improved description for the Lure item, to make its purpose clearer.
[*]Clarified prices in shops. [i]E.g.,"-4 Evil Blood" -> "4 EB"[/i]
[/list]

[h2]🐛 Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug with blinking transitions menus.
[*]Fixed bug where a freeze could occur when 2 plans were discovered in the same session.
[*]Fixed bug with tooltips triggering incorrectly when fighting enemies.
[*]Attempted fix of cards remaining stuck to the cursor instead of returning to their place.
[*]Fixed bug where the screen would shake when entering a fight, despite the player having turned off screen shake in settings.
[*]Fixed missing relic slot in UI.
[*]Fixed bug with portal spawning an enemy each time the game was restarted.
[*]Fixed bug with [i]Discover Plan: Campfire[/i] quest not being checked if starting a new game with it unlocked.
[*]Fixed bug with the gauge bar on an exploration card not disappearing when removing a villager.
[*]Fixed bug where banana tree could soft lock when skipping the prologue after a restart.
[*]Fixed bug with Evil Blood being consumed by the Altar.
[*]Fixed bugs that could occur with the border along the board.
[*]Fixed bug with animation sequences when fighting two or three enemies.
[*]Fixed incorrect animations playing for misses, poison, and slashes.
[*]Fixed issue where some buttons would be off-screen for players with wider screens.
[*]Fixed Steam achievement: [i]Endurance[/i] should now unlock after surviving to Day 25.
[*]Fixed Steam achievement: [i]Pious[/i] should now unlock when praying at the totem.

notes.title: Kaya's Prophecy is joining Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Guess what, Kaya's Prophecy is going to be taking part in the Steam Next Fest running from 24th February to 3rd March! This is your chance to try out our unique village builder that challenges your strategic skills and resource management!

[h2]🎮 Our Next Fest demo has some upgrades:[/h2]

[h3]Gameplay & Story[/h3]
[list]
[*]added a new introduction sequence, with an exploration and updated story with animated event
[*]added a currency (cassowary coins) to buy stuff in the exploration shop
[*]new quest
[*]new event during exploration
[/list]
This demo is just a taste of what's to come in the full release. We'd love to hear your feedback after you've played!

[h2]🖥️ Yogscast Stream Alert![/h2]

The amazing folks at [url=https://www.twitch.tv/yogscast]The Yogscast[/url] will be streaming Kaya's Prophecy on [b]Wednesday, February 26th at 13:00 GMT![/b] You'll be able to see the game in action with these awesome content creators.

[h2] 🎁Competition Time??[/h2]

In case you'd like to try your chance at getting a copy of Kaya's Prophecy on launch, why not show us how much you know about the game by participating in our quiz competition!

Drop by, try the demo, and let us know what you think. Your input is incredibly valuable as we continue development.

See you during Next Fest!

notes.title: It's Time to Unwrap Your Gifts, the Second Playtest Is Here!
notes.content:
The second Kaya's Prophecy playtest has arrived, and we're taking your tribal journey to the next level!
Build, explore, and battle in a vibrant roguelite where every decision shapes your tribe's destiny. Do your best to placate your god... who will be demanding some tasty treats! (though perhaps a slightly... [i]untraditional[/i] Christmas dinner!) After our first playtest, we've refined the experience with some new features and bug fixes! Peep the at the bottom of this announcement

Whether you're a returning player or a new tribal leader, the second playtest awaits.
Join the playtest on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3051470/Kayas_Prophecy/]Steam[/url] and continue your tribe's epic story!

[h3]✨Features[/h3]
[list]
[*]Improved stacking physics of cards on your board
[*]Changed how plans are kept between runs
[*]Tweaked environment lights and colours
[*]Added display settings, players can now play the game in windowed mode
[*]Added the options/menu button in the fight screens and exploration screens 
[*]Animals now move around less
[*]Reworked quests
[*]Updated behaviour of pinned plans
[*]Improved [b]save[/b] and [b]load[/b] systems[/list]

[h3]🐞Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Now displays the correct number of quests in chapter
[*]No longer destroys exploration card with thunder.
[*]Fixed an issue with a fight launching twice upon reloading, if quitting during a fight.
[*]Fixed an issue where the [b]vision[/b] menu would not open correctly if dropped on a villager[/list]
